Q. 3 اِغْرَنْدَاهُ , (K,) and اِغْرَنْدَى عَلَيْهِ, (AZ, S, K,) inf. n. اِغْرِنْدَآءٌ, (AZ, S,) He overcame him; (A'Obeyd, K;) he set upon him, or assailed him, or overcame him, with reviling and beating and violence; (AZ, A'Obeyd, S, K;) like اِغْلَنْتَى (AZ, A'Obeyd, S,) and اِسْرَنْدَى. (TA. [See the last of these verbs, in art. سرد, and the verse there cited.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
